key_takeaway: Boom's AI is the only platform in short-term rental that actively designs and crafts guest experiences — not just fast replies — and can act as the institutional knowledge base across Upstay's 500 Guesty listings, with zero AI training required on your side.
summary_bullets: Your team lives and breathes guest experience — Boom's adaptive AI (Zoe) personalizes every conversation from the reservation level, discloses it's AI transparently, and still keeps guests engaged and upselling naturally.

You flagged high staff turnover and knowledge trapped in Slack — BAM becomes your institutional knowledge base, instantly answering questions like 'how many times was leak mentioned in the last 6 months?' and onboarding new account managers.
You're running 6–8 tools on top of Guesty — Boom consolidates guest, owner, contractor and team communication into one CRM and layers AI + Breezeway on top, with no need to replace your PMS.
executive_summary: An intro session for Upstay's COO Bonnie Li, focused on guest experience and intentional upselling. Sabrina (Boom operator partner, 650-key Malta portfolio) demoed adaptive AI guest communication and BAM agentic AI; Idan covered onboarding, CRM and review management. Bonnie's priorities: AI as an institutional knowledge base, phone-call handling, and OTA review management. Both sides agreed to a deeper follow-up with Upstay's full guest-experience and owner-experience teams.

discussion_points.title: What we heard from Upstay
items: High staff turnover — knowledge walks out the door, and new account managers take time to get up to speed.
Critical operational knowledge is scattered across Slack channels (work orders, local team alerts, issues).
Roughly 6–8 disconnected tools sitting on top of Guesty (Enzo Connect, PriceLabs, Sparrow, Slack).
Managing OTA reviews and wanting AI that can eventually handle guest phone calls.

discussion_points.title: How Boom addresses it
items: Adaptive AI guest communication (Zoe) — personalizes tone and name per guest, discloses it's AI transparently, and drives gentle, intentional upselling.
BAM agentic AI — your 'Chief Action Officer': natural-language reports, bulk guest actions, custom dashboards on demand, and available directly inside Slack.
Institutional knowledge base — query historical guest communications and onboard new team members instantly.
Review management — AI handles 4★+ reviews across OTA channels; sub-4★ routed to humans, with auto service-call creation on maintenance/housekeeping issues.
Onboarding is a Guesty API key and ~10 minutes — 'the training is on us, the modification is on you.'

discussion_points.title: Where this goes next
items: Intentional upselling that begins pre-arrival (travel quiz → curated itinerary) rather than a cold shop link.
Owner-facing performance reports (positive and negative review trends by property), fully customizable.
AI phone-call handling is in advanced testing and can already run in the test environment.

demo_highlights.benefit: A 15-minute WhatsApp exchange that ends in a sunset drink and a handwritten note — upselling that feels like concierge, not a sales pitch.
When guests ask 'are you human?', Zoe warmly says she's AI — and engagement doesn't drop.
A scheduled 8am report covering maintenance, unresolved guest issues and check-in readiness — replacing manual human handovers.
One sentence spins up a live arrivals / departures / cleaning / unread-messages screen, saved for the whole company.
Tag BAM in your channels like a senior teammate to query history and run service calls — meeting your team where they already work.
Ask 'how many times was leak mentioned in the last 6 months?' across all guest communications in seconds.
